# Naming Normalization — Canonical Map

`id`/`disposition` and the Cluster Zero matrix fields). Narrative background: `docs/naming/decision-records.md` (non-authoritative).

## Naming standard

- **Language rule.** Engineering = English (files, folders, modules, symbols, DTOs, schemas, events, queues, jobs, routes, tables, columns, migrations, test descriptions, technical comments, technical docs, env/config keys, i18n keys). Portuguese only in what the end user sees in the frontend (labels, titles, messages, placeholders, tooltips, visible errors, buttons, options, confirmations) and in tests that assert that visible text.
- **Acronyms.** Acronyms and abbreviations are cased as words inside identifiers: Dto, Id, Url, Api, Uuid, Json, Http, Ai, Hr, Crm, Rbac, Kpi, Isrc, Upc, Ecad, Pdf (measured 2026-09-26: Dto 1782 vs DTO 5, Id 14975 vs ID 0, Url 1747 vs URL 87 (mostly the URL global), Api 2613 vs API 3, Ai 386 vs AI 219, Hr 42 vs HR 1, Crm 213 vs CRM 93, Isrc 111 vs ISRC 33). ALL-CAPS only in SCREAMING_SNAKE constants and env vars, and in library-defined names (IsUUID, ParseUUIDPipe, URL, JSON, URLSearchParams).
- **databaseTable.** plural snake_case (artists, releases, project_tracks)
- **databaseColumn.** singular snake_case; foreign keys <entity>_id (artist_id, release_id)
- **entityClass.** singular PascalCase + Entity (ArtistEntity, ReleaseEntity)
- **apiModuleFolder.** plural kebab-case resource (artists/, releases/, contract-templates/)
- **controllerServiceRepository.** plural resource + role (ArtistsController, ArtistsService); single-purpose services are named by responsibility (ReleaseReadinessService)
- **routePath.** plural kebab-case resource (/artists, /releases/:id/tracks)
- **dto.** verb/purpose + singular + Dto (CreateArtistDto, UpdateReleaseDto, QueryContractDto)
- **frontendModuleFolder.** kebab-case domain (catalog/, releases/, crm-relationships/)
- **component.** singular PascalCase for a single record (ReleaseFormModal, ContactViewModal); plural for list pages (Releases.tsx)
- **hook.** use + plural for collections (useReleases), use + singular for one record (useRelease)
- **typeInterface.** singular PascalCase (Release, ReleaseInsert, ReleaseWithRelations)
- **eventName.** <aggregate>.<past-tense verb> lowercase (release.distributed, contract.signed)
- **queueJobName.** kebab-case (ai-jobs, integrations-sync; job names kebab or <provider>:<action>)
- **envVar.** SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE English (VITE_ prefix for frontend-exposed)
- **testDescription.** English behavior sentence; quoted Portuguese only for the user-visible text being asserted (it("shows 'Salvar projeto' when editing a project"))

## Canonical technical glossary

| Term | Definition | Disallowed ambiguous usages | Related terms | ID namespace |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| project | A music or audiovisual production effort owned by a tenant (projects / audiovisual_projects / marketing_projects are distinct aggregates — qualify when ambiguous: AudiovisualProject, MarketingProject). | bare 'project' for marketing or audiovisual work | track, audiovisual project, marketing project | projectId = projects.id (tenant-scoped uuid); audiovisual/marketing projects use audiovisualProjectId / marketingProjectId |
| artist | A performer/creator managed by the tenant (artists table). Identity on external platforms is an ArtistPlatformProfile, never the artist id itself. | artistId holding a provider/platform id — use <provider>ArtistId or externalId | platform, artist platform profile, track | artistId = artists.id (internal uuid). External ids are namespaced: spotifyArtistId, soundchartsArtistUuid, youtubeChannelId, instagramUserId |
| release | A MUSIC release (single/EP/album) distributed to DSPs (releases table, ReleaseEntity). Portuguese UX: 'Lançamento'. Not a software release and not an accounting entry. | 'release' for deployments (use 'deployment'/'appRelease') and 'lancamento' for ledger entries (use 'transaction') | track, distribution, phonogram | releaseId = releases.id; distributor-side ids: <distributor>ReleaseId, upc |
| track | One recording inside a release or project (release tracks, project_tracks). Portuguese UX: 'Faixa'/'Música'. | 'music'/'song' as structural names | release, project, phonogram | projectTrackId = project_tracks.id; isrc identifies the recording externally |
| work | A musical composition (works table) — the copyright in the song. Portuguese UX: 'Obra'. | 'song' for the composition | phonogram, split | workId = works.id; iswc and society work codes are external |
| phonogram | A sound recording of a work (phonograms table) — the master/recording right. Portuguese UX: 'Fonograma'. | 'recording' as a table/FK name (no recordings table exists) | work, track | phonogramId = phonograms.id; isrc external |
| contract | A legal agreement managed in contracts (artist/client/licensing agreements, signed via Autentique/DocuSign). | 'contract' for API/type contracts in domain code — use 'apiContract'/'schema' | customer, artist, provider | contractId = contracts.id; provider document ids: autentiqueDocumentId / docusignEnvelopeId (stored as autentique_doc_id / metadata.provider_doc_id) |
| transaction | A financial ledger entry (transactions v1; financial_transactions v2 scaffolded). Portuguese UX: 'Lançamento financeiro'/'Transação'. | 'transaction' for DB transactions in domain names — use 'dbTransaction'/'manager' | invoice, payment, split | transactionId = transactions.id (v1 ledger) |
| invoice | A billing document: tenant fiscal invoices (NFS-e, type != stripe_subscription) or SaaS Stripe invoices (type = stripe_subscription) in the same invoices table — always qualify (FiscalInvoice / StripeSubscriptionInvoice) when the distinction matters. | treating both invoice kinds as one concept in dunning | transaction, payment, subscription | invoiceId = invoices.id; stripeInvoiceId for SaaS invoices |
| subscription | The tenant's SaaS plan subscription with the platform (billing_subscriptions, Stripe). | 'subscription' for realtime/event subscriptions without qualification | billing, organization, payment | billing_subscriptions.id; stripeSubscriptionId; scoped by orgId |
| customer | A client of the tenant (clients table). Portuguese UX: 'Cliente'/'Contato'. The Stripe customer of the platform is 'stripeCustomer'. | bare 'customer' for the Stripe customer | contact, lead, organization | clientId = clients.id (tenant customer); stripeCustomerId = the platform customer in Stripe |
| account | Never bare. Qualify: userAccount (auth identity), billingAccount/stripeCustomer (SaaS billing), socialAccount/oauthConnection (connected provider login), societyAccount (collecting society), bankAccount (payout). | bare 'account' | user, member, integration, subscription | never bare accountId: societyAccountId, stripeCustomerId, oauthConnectionId, bankAccountId |
| tenant | The isolation boundary for business data (tenants table, tenant_id, RLS app_current_tenant_id()). | 'user' or 'account' meaning tenant | organization, workspace, member | tenantId = tenants.id (RLS key app_current_tenant_id()) |
| organization | The owner of one or more tenants (organizations table, org_id); billing and subscription are org-scoped. | 'company' for this boundary | tenant, subscription, billing | orgId = organizations.id (RLS key app_current_org_id()) |
| workspace | Product term for the org+tenant pair created at signup (WorkspaceProvisioningService). Not a separate table. | using 'workspace' as a third isolation key | organization, tenant | no own id: a workspace is (orgId, tenantId) |
| user | An authenticated person (users table, auth_user_id); tenant membership is an OrgMember/membership with a role. | 'user' meaning tenant or member role | member, tenant | userId = users.id (internal); authUserId = identity-provider (Supabase auth) user id |
| member | A user's membership in an org/tenant with a role (org_members). | 'user' when the membership is meant | user, organization, tenant | memberId = org_members.id |
| lead | A CRM prospect not yet converted (leads table). Portuguese UX: 'Lead'. | 'contact' for leads | contact, customer, campaign | leadId = leads.id |
| contact | A CRM contact, physically a clients row ('Contato = Cliente', ContactsService facade over ClientsService). | 'contact' for a lead or for artist team contacts (ArtistTeamContact) | customer, lead | contactId = clientId (same clients row) |
| campaign | A marketing campaign (campaigns table). | 'campaign' for lead conditional payloads without qualification | lead, metric, project | campaignId = campaigns.id |
| distribution | Delivery of a release to DSPs through a distributor (release status DISTRIBUTED, distributor). Portuguese UX: 'Distribuição'. | 'distribution' for statistical distributions in domain code | release, provider | distributor ids are namespaced per distributor |
| royalty | Income owed to rights holders from exploitation of works/phonograms. | 'royalty' for platform fees | split, transaction, work, phonogram | — |
| split | A percentage share of rights/royalties (shares table: party_role, percentage). Portuguese UX: 'Share'/'Rateio'. | 'split' for string splitting in domain names | royalty, work, phonogram, release | shareId = shares.id |
| payment | Money movement settling an invoice/transaction (payment_events for Stripe; transaction payment fields). | 'payment' for the SaaS subscription itself | invoice, transaction, subscription | payment_events.stripe_event_id (Stripe event), transaction payment fields |
| billing | The platform's SaaS billing of tenants (billing_* tables, Stripe, dunning via tenant_billing_state). | 'billing' for the tenant's own invoicing of its customers (use 'invoicing') | subscription, invoice, organization | tenant_billing_state keyed by tenantId; billing_subscriptions by orgId |
| platform | An external music/social platform (Spotify, YouTube, Instagram, ...) where an artist has a profile (artist_platform_profiles). | 'platform' for the MUSIC OS 360 product itself (use 'app'/'system') | artist, provider, metric | platform = enum key (spotify, youtube, instagram, ...); platform-side ids are <platform>...Id |
| provider | An external service vendor behind an integration (Stripe, Autentique, DocuSign, Soundcharts, WhatsApp Cloud). | mixing 'provider' (vendor) with 'platform' (where the artist is) | integration, platform | provider = enum key of the vendor (stripe, autentique, docusign, soundcharts, whatsapp) |
| integration | A configured connection between a tenant and a provider (integrations / oauth_connections). | 'integration' for integration tests in domain names | provider, account | integrationId = integrations.id; oauthConnectionId = oauth_connections.id |
| metric | A measured value (followers, streams) captured as a snapshot (artist_metric_snapshots). | estimated values presented as measured metrics | platform, insight, artist | artist_metric_snapshots.id; metric keys are English snake_case |
| insight | A derived, AI/automation-produced interpretation of metrics (analytics-insights automation), never a raw metric. | 'insight' for raw data | metric | — |
| employee | A person employed by the tenant itself (employees table; CLT/PJ/freelancer/intern), administered in the hr module. | employee for artists, users or tenant members | user, member | employeeId = employees.id |
| license | A music licensing / sync agreement granting use of a work or phonogram (licenses table). | license for SaaS plans (use subscription/plan), license as a synonym of contract | contract, work, phonogram | licenseId = licenses.id |
| inventory item | A physical equipment/asset tracked by the tenant (inventory_items table). | asset (reserved for uploaded media assets) | employee | inventoryItemId = inventory_items.id |
| calendar | Always qualified: EventsCalendar (operational events: shows, tours, appointments) vs ContentCalendar (marketing content schedule). | bare Calendar | event, campaign | — |
| task | Always qualified: MarketingTask (marketing_tasks), AudiovisualTask (audiovisual_tasks), OperationalTask (operational_tasks); a queue job is a job, never a task. | bare task for queue jobs | project, campaign | marketingTaskId / audiovisualTaskId / operationalTaskId |

## Blockers

| ID | Item | Exact blocker | Evidence | Independent work completed | Required action |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BLK-C3-E6 | Drop events.data (C3/E6) | Destructive schema change: needs explicit owner authorization and a release that only reads starts_at deployed to every environment; the reports events contract must move from col('data') to starts_at with a header-compatible label in the same change. | migration 20260928000007 (E3/E5 + sync trigger); CZ-029 | — | After the E4 web/api release is live everywhere: switch the reports contract to starts_at keeping the 'Data' header accepted on import, stop the service dual-write, drop trg_events_sync_start_columns and events.data in one authorized migration. |
| BLK-HR-LEGACY-MIRRORS | employees.legacy_full_name/legacy_sector/legacy_base_salary, payroll_entries.legacy_employee_id/legacy_reference_month, leave_requests.legacy_employee_id | Unmapped mirror columns of mapped canonical columns (name, department, salary, employee_id, reference_month). Dropping them is destructive and needs a data reconciliation against the canonical column in every environment. | migration 20260928000008 (renamed legacy_*); 20260712000003 added them as form mirrors the service never kept in sync | — | Compare each legacy_* value with its canonical column in DEV/STAGING/PROD; copy anything meaningful into the canonical column; then drop the legacy_* columns in an authorized migration. |
| BLK-HR-PII | employees.birth_date, address, rg (collected by the employee form, never persisted) | Product + security decision: persisting these personal fields plaintext (cpf/email/phone are encrypted) or removing them from the form. | EmployeeFormModal collects rg/birthDate/address; CreateEmployeeDto never accepted them; columns exist unmapped (20260712000003) | — | Owner decides: persist with field-level encryption (EncryptionService, like cpf) or remove the inputs; implement accordingly. |
